description: Upload and add a new Image to a Project's Photo Album (Image Category).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Image. Use as the {id} path segment in GET/PATCH/DELETE /rest/v1.0/images/{id}.

url.description: Time-limited URL to download the full-resolution image file. Null when the image has been permanently deleted.

thumbnail_url.description: Time-limited URL to the large thumbnail. Null when the image has been permanently deleted.

taken_at.description: Timestamp the photo was captured, from EXIF exposure metadata, in ISO 8601 format. Null when the source file has no capture date.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to Location

permanently_deleted.description: True when the image is marked as permanently deleted.

projection.description: Spatial projection of the image. '360' marks a panoramic photo, which clients render in a dedicated 360 viewer; such images are also eligible for tile generation, but only when the file is larger t...

image_category_private.description: Whether the Image's category is marked private. Mirrors the private flag of the Image's Image Category.

origin_id.description: ID of the source record this Image originated from (for example, a Daily Log entry). Null when the Image was uploaded directly.

daily_log_header_id.description: ID of the Daily Log day this Image is attached to. Null when the Image is not associated with a Daily Log.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the segment was soft deleted

deleted.description: Indicates if the segment is deleted

gps_lat.description: GPS latitude extracted from the image EXIF metadata, as a decimal-degrees string. Null when the image has no embedded location data.

gps_long.description: GPS longitude extracted from the image EXIF metadata, as a decimal-degrees string. Null when the image has no embedded location data.

self.description: A link back to the current resource

update.description: A link to the update endpoint for the resource

delete.description: A link to the delete endpoint for the resource

permanentlyDelete.description: A link to the permanent delete endpoint for the resource

retrieve.description: A link to the retrieve endpoint for the resource

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to Trade

comments_count.description: the number of comments on this image

heading_degrees.description: Compass bearing the camera was facing (True North). 0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W. Range [0, 360).

heading_accuracy_degrees.description: Maximum angular deviation of heading_degrees from the true bearing, in degrees. Range [0, 180].

altitude_meters.description: Height of the camera above reference datum.

roll_degrees.description: Camera rotation about viewing axis. 0=level. Range [-180, 180].

upload_uuid.description: UUID referencing a previously completed Upload. This is the recommended approach for image uploads. See Company Uploads or Project Uploads for instructions on how use uploads. You should not use bo...

source_image_id.description: ID of an existing Image in the same project to copy. Creates a new independent Image with its own file storage. Mutually exclusive with upload_uuid and data. When provided, image_name is not requir...

image_name.description: The name of the image file to be uploaded. Required when using an upload_uuid to upload the image. Not required when using source_image_id.

image.description: At least one attribute is required even when an 'upload_uuid' or 'source_image_id' key is provided. If neither is provided, then the 'data' key must be provided

private.description: The Private status of the Image. Defaults to a project configuration.

provider_type.description: Provider type. Currently supports only `MarkupLayer`, and should only be used when adding an Image to markup.

provider_id.description: Provider ID. Currently supports only MarkupLayer IDs, and should only be used when adding an Image to markup.

starred.description: The Starred status of the Image.

location_id.description: If you want to use an existing location and you have the ID of that existing location use this. `location_id` takes precedence over `mt_location`

mt_location.description: Use this for creating a new multi-tier or single-tier Location. This will be ignored if `location_id` is provided.

trade_ids.description: An array of IDs of the Trades of the Image
